summary: Nomadic raiding civ. Every building can pack up and move, stables come in the Dark Age, and Stone doubles unit production.

spikes.label: Dark Age raids
spikes.detail: Stables in the Dark Age and fast-training horsemen mean early raids.
spikes.answer: Spearmen early and keep villagers close to the Town Center.

spikes.label: Mangudai
spikes.detail: Mangudai are hard to catch and shoot while moving. Their moving attack was slowed this patch.

spikes.label: Double production
spikes.detail: Stone pays for doubled units and advanced upgrades.

winConditions.detail: Raids that cripple the enemy economy.
